points.title: 少年求学
points.description: 王阳明出生于浙江余姚一个书香门第，父亲王华是成化年间的状元。自幼聪颖过人，但性格活泼好动，不喜拘束。少年时期曾一度沉迷于兵法，后又转向儒学，展现出对学问的广泛兴趣。12岁时立志做圣贤，17岁时随父赴京，拜谒理学大师娄谅，开始系统学习程朱理学。这一时期奠定了他深厚的学术基础，也埋下了后来对理学进行反思的种子。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a scholarly family in Yuyao, Zhejiang, Wang Yangming showed exceptional intelligence from a young age. His father, Wang Hua, was the top scholar in the imperial examination of 1481. As a youth, Wang was initially fascinated by military strategy before turning to Confucian studies. At age 12, he resolved to become a sage, and at 17, he studied under the Neo-Confucian master Liang Liang in Beijing, laying the foundation for his later philosophical development.

points.title: 科举入仕
points.description: 1492年，王阳明参加乡试中举，1499年考中进士，正式步入仕途。在北京期间，他历任工部主事、兵部主事等职。这一时期，他深入研究朱熹理学，但逐渐对朱熹'格物致知'的方法产生怀疑。一次格竹七日而不得其理的经历，使他开始质疑程朱理学的权威。同时，他结交了湛若水等学者，思想开始形成自己的特色，为后来心学的创立奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1492, Wang passed the provincial examination, and in 1499, he passed the highest imperial examination, beginning his official career in Beijing. During this period, he served in various positions in the Ministry of Works and Ministry of Military Affairs. While deeply studying Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism, he began to question the 'investigation of things' approach. His famous experience of attempting to understand the principle of bamboo through extended observation led him to doubt the authority of Zhu Xi's philosophy.

points.title: 龙场悟道
points.description: 1506年，因反对宦官刘瑾专权，王阳明被贬谪至贵州龙场（今修文县）担任驿丞。在艰苦的环境中，他日夜反思，终于在一个夜晚顿悟'心即理'的道理，创立了'知行合一'的思想。这一突破性领悟成为他心学的核心。在龙场期间，他还创办了龙岗书院，开始传播自己的思想。龙场悟道是王阳明思想发展的关键转折点，标志着他从程朱理学转向心学的决定性一步。
points.descriptionEn: In 1506, Wang was exiled to Longchang, Guizhou (present-day Xiuwen County) as a postal station chief for opposing the powerful eunuch Liu Jin. In this harsh environment, he engaged in deep reflection and experienced a sudden enlightenment, realizing that 'the mind is the principle' (xin ji li). This breakthrough led to his formulation of the unity of knowledge and action (zhi xing he yi). During this period, he also founded Longgang Academy to begin spreading his teachings. This enlightenment marked a pivotal turning point in Wang's philosophical development.

points.title: 平定叛乱
points.description: 1516年，王阳明被任命为南赣巡抚，负责平定江西、福建、广东交界处的匪患。他运用'知行合一'的思想，不仅军事上取得胜利，还推行'十家牌法'等社会治理措施，从根本上解决了地方治安问题。1519年，宁王朱宸濠发动叛乱，王阳明迅速组织兵力，仅用43天就平定了叛乱。这一系列军事行动充分体现了他的军事才能和'致良知'思想的实践应用，证明了他的思想不仅限于理论，还能有效解决实际问题。
points.descriptionEn: In 1516, Wang was appointed as the Surveillance Commissioner for Nan-Gan, responsible for suppressing banditry in the border regions of Jiangxi, Fujian, and Guangdong. Applying his philosophy of the unity of knowledge and action, he not only achieved military success but also implemented social governance measures like the 'Ten-Household Registration System' to fundamentally address local security issues. In 1519, when Prince Zhu Chenhao rebelled, Wang quickly organized forces and suppressed the rebellion in just 43 days, demonstrating both his military talent and practical application of his philosophy.

points.title: 讲学授徒
points.description: 1521年，明世宗即位后，王阳明被召回京城，但因朝中党争激烈，他请求归乡讲学。在绍兴期间，他创办了稽山书院、阳明书院等教育机构，广泛传播心学思想。这一时期，他的思想体系更加成熟，形成了完整的'致良知'理论。他强调'心外无物，心外无理'，主张通过内心的道德自觉达到'万物一体'的境界。他的讲学活动吸引了众多弟子，形成了著名的'姚江学派'，对后世产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After Emperor Shizong ascended the throne in 1521, Wang was recalled to the capital but requested to return home to teach due to court factionalism. In Shaoxing, he founded educational institutions like Jishan Academy and Yangming Academy, widely spreading his philosophy of the Mind School. During this period, his philosophical system matured, forming a complete theory of 'extending innate knowledge' (zhi liangzhi). He emphasized that 'there is nothing outside the mind, and there is no principle outside the mind,' advocating achieving the state of 'unity with all things' through moral self-awareness.

points.title: 晚年征讨
points.description: 1527年，朝廷再次起用王阳明，命他前往广西平定思恩、田州等地的叛乱。此时他已年近六旬，体弱多病，但仍毅然赴任。在广西期间，他采取'剿抚并用'的策略，既武力平叛，又推行教化，成功解决了边疆问题。1528年，他完成《大学问》等重要著作，系统阐述了自己的思想体系。1529年，在返回途中病逝于江西南安，享年57岁。临终前，弟子问他有何遗言，他只说了'此心光明，亦复何言'八个字，体现了他一生追求光明磊落的精神境界。
points.descriptionEn: In 1527, the imperial court again summoned Wang, now nearly 60 and in poor health, to suppress rebellions in Ensi and Tianzhou in Guangxi. Despite his age and illness, he accepted the appointment. In Guangxi, he employed a strategy combining military action with moral persuasion, successfully resolving the border issues. In 1528, he completed important works like 'Great Learning Inquiry,' systematically expounding his philosophical system. In 1529, while returning home, he died in Nan'an, Jiangxi at age 57. When asked his final words, he simply said, 'This mind is bright; what more is there to say?' reflecting his lifelong pursuit of moral clarity.

appraisal.zh: 王阳明被视为中国思想史上的转折人物，其心学与程朱理学并称儒学两大主流，「知行合一」「致良知」影响远及东亚与西方，兼有政军事功，体现「内圣外王」的理想。也有研究者指出，其学偏重主观心性而轻客观规范，或流于道德相对主义，「心即理」失之简化，体系亦欠严密；军旅手段严酷，政治上终未越出明王朝与专制体制。
appraisal.en: Wang Yangming is regarded as a pivotal figure in Chinese intellectual history: his School of the Mind stands with Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism as one of two major streams, his ideas of the unity of knowledge and action and extending innate knowledge reached East Asia and the West, and his political and military achievements embody the ideal of 'inner sage, outer king.' Yet researchers also note that his thought stresses subjective mind-nature over objective norms, risking moral relativism; that 'the mind is principle' oversimplifies moral cognition and his system lacks rigor; and that his campaigns were harsh and he never broke with the Ming autocracy.

supporter.zh: 王阳明被后世尊为'阳明先生'，是中国历史上少数集政治家、军事家、哲学家于一身的思想巨匠。他的'心学'思想打破了程朱理学的桎梏，开创了中国哲学的新境界。'知行合一'和'致良知'的理念强调道德实践的重要性，对后世产生了深远影响。他不仅在学术上有重大贡献，在政治和军事上也展现了卓越才能，平定叛乱、治理地方，体现了儒家'内圣外王'的理想人格。
supporter.en: Wang Yangming is revered as 'Master Yangming' in Chinese history, one of the few figures who excelled as a statesman, military strategist, and philosopher. His 'School of the Mind' broke free from the constraints of Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism, opening new horizons in Chinese philosophy. His concepts of 'unity of knowledge and action' and 'extending innate knowledge' emphasized the importance of moral practice, profoundly influencing later generations. He not only made significant academic contributions but also demonstrated exceptional abilities in politics and military affairs, embodying the Confucian ideal of 'inner sage, outer king'.

critic.zh: 批评者认为王阳明的心学过于强调主观心性，忽视了客观知识和外在规范，可能导致道德相对主义。他的'心即理'观点被批评为过于简化了复杂的道德认知过程。此外，他的军事行动虽然成功，但也使用了较为残酷的手段，如对叛乱者的镇压。在政治立场上，他虽反对宦官专权，但在大节上仍服务于明王朝，未能从根本上挑战封建专制制度。他的思想体系也被批评为缺乏系统性和严密性，与西方哲学相比显得不够严谨。
critic.en: Critics argue that Wang's philosophy overemphasizes subjective mind-nature while neglecting objective knowledge and external norms, potentially leading to moral relativism. His concept of 'the mind is the principle' is criticized for oversimplifying the complex process of moral cognition. Additionally, while his military campaigns were successful, they involved harsh measures against rebels. Politically, although he opposed eunuch power, he ultimately served the Ming Dynasty without fundamentally challenging feudal autocracy. His philosophical system is also criticized for lacking systematic rigor compared to Western philosophy.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，王阳明被视为中国思想史上的转折点人物，他的心学思想与程朱理学并称中国儒学的两大主流。在流行文化中，'知行合一'和'致良知'的理念被广泛应用于现代管理学、心理学和教育学领域。王阳明的一生体现了中国传统知识分子'达则兼济天下，穷则独善其身'的处世哲学。他的思想不仅影响了东亚各国，还通过传教士传入西方，成为东西方文化交流的重要桥梁。当代学者普遍认为，王阳明的心学思想对解决现代社会中的道德困境和精神危机仍具有重要启示意义。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Wang is regarded as a pivotal figure in Chinese intellectual history, his School of the Mind standing alongside Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism as two major streams of Confucian thought. In popular culture, his concepts of 'unity of knowledge and action' and 'extending innate knowledge' are widely applied in modern management, psychology, and education. Wang's life embodies the traditional Chinese scholar's philosophy of 'serving the world when in power, cultivating oneself when in obscurity.' His influence extended beyond East Asia and was introduced to the West through missionaries, becoming an important bridge in East-West cultural exchange. Contemporary scholars generally agree that Wang's philosophy still offers valuable insights for addressing modern moral dilemmas and spiritual crises.
